mock_data.title: Computer Crime
mock_data.passage:
Computers have become so necessary to modern living that it is difficult to believe that they are a relatively recent invention. Undoubtedly, they have proved to be of great value, but they also have their disadvantages. For one thing, they have added to our already large number of crimes.

Hacking was the first computer crime that most of us became aware of. By using their computing expertise, people known as hackers can gain unauthorized access to someone else's computer and make use of the data which they find there. They may, for example, get hold of lists of the names of their competitors' clients and use these to build up their own businesses, or they may use hacking as a form of industrial espionage to find out a rival company's plans. Other hacking activities may be more obviously criminal, in that hackers may log on to financial data in someone else's computer and either alter it illegally or use it for fraudulent purposes.

The possibility of serious financial fraud has been greatly increased by the modern practice of purchasing goods through the Internet. Apparently, the use of credit cards to pay for such purchases has led to record levels of fraud with a great many people being swindled out of a great deal of money. Banks are working hard to improve online security and to provide safeguards for customers, but fraudsters are working just as hard to improve their crooked techniques.

Many computer users worry in case their systems are affected by computer viruses. The people who introduce such bugs into other people's computer programs may not technically be committing a crime, but may be doing so as an act of mischief or spite. The motive does not really matter to the people whose data has been deleted or altered or whose files have been corrupted.

Computers are part of a highly technical method of working, in which there are constantly new developments. Unfortunately, there is also a constant stream of new developments in the fraud industry associated with them. All computer users must be on their guard.
mock_data.passageB1:
Computers are now a very important part of our lives. It's hard to believe they are quite new. They have been very useful but they also have problems. One problem is that they have created new types of crime.

One of the first computer crimes people knew about was hacking. Hackers are people who are good with computers. They can access other people's computers without permission. They can then use the information they find. For example, they might find a list of a company's customers and use it to help their own business. This is like spying on another company to learn their secrets. Some hackers do more serious things. They might look at financial information and change it or use it to steal money.

It's now very common to buy things online using the Internet. You often pay with a credit card. This has led to a lot of fraud. Many people have been tricked out of their money. Banks are trying to make online shopping safer. They are trying to protect their customers. But people who commit fraud are also trying to find new ways to cheat.

Many computer users are worried about computer viruses. These are programs that can damage your computer. The people who make viruses might not always be doing something illegal. Sometimes they just want to cause trouble. But it doesn't matter why they do it if your computer data is lost or changed.

Computers and the way we use them are always changing. Sadly, the ways that people commit fraud are also always changing. All computer users need to be careful and aware of the risks.
mock_data.passageB2:
Computers have become so integral to modern life that it’s hard to believe they are a relatively recent invention. While they’ve undeniably proven their worth, they also present certain drawbacks. One significant issue is the increase in computer-related crimes.

Hacking was perhaps the first computer crime to gain widespread attention. Hackers, using their specialized knowledge, can illegitimately access another person's computer and exploit the data they find. For instance, they might obtain client lists from competitors and use them to bolster their own businesses, or engage in industrial espionage to uncover a rival company's strategies. Other hacking activities are more overtly criminal, such as accessing financial records and manipulating them for fraudulent purposes.

The risk of serious financial fraud has been significantly exacerbated by the prevalence of online shopping. The use of credit cards for these transactions has apparently led to unprecedented levels of fraud, with many individuals being defrauded of substantial sums of money. Banks are actively working to enhance online security and provide protection for customers, but fraudsters are equally determined to refine their deceptive methods. This ongoing battle creates a constant challenge for both consumers and financial institutions.

Many computer users are understandably concerned about the possibility of their systems being infected by computer viruses. While those who introduce these viruses into other people's programs may not always be technically committing a crime, they may be acting out of malice or simply to cause trouble. Regardless of the motive, the consequences can be devastating for those whose data is deleted, altered, or whose files are corrupted. It's important to take precautions to protect your computer from these threats.

Computers are part of a constantly evolving technological landscape. Unfortunately, the world of computer-related fraud is also undergoing constant change. It is imperative that all computer users remain vigilant and exercise caution when using their devices. Staying informed about the latest threats and security measures is crucial to mitigate the risks associated with computer crime.
mock_data.passageC1:
The ubiquity of computers in contemporary life renders it almost inconceivable that they are a relatively recent innovation. While they have undoubtedly proved invaluable across numerous sectors, their proliferation has also spawned a new breed of criminal activity, thereby exacerbating the challenges faced by law enforcement and cybersecurity professionals.

Hacking, perhaps the earliest form of computer crime to capture public attention, involves individuals, often referred to as hackers, exploiting their advanced computing skills to gain unfettered access to computer systems without authorization. The motivations behind such intrusions are diverse, ranging from the theft of sensitive business data, such as client lists, to facilitate unfair competitive advantages, to engaging in industrial espionage aimed at uncovering a rival company's strategic plans. In more overtly criminal scenarios, hackers may target financial databases, manipulating records or exploiting vulnerabilities for fraudulent gain.

The surge in online commerce has magnified the potential for large-scale financial fraud. The prevalent use of credit cards for internet purchases has seemingly fueled an unprecedented rise in fraudulent activities, resulting in substantial financial losses for countless individuals. While financial institutions are endeavouring to bolster online security and implement robust customer protection measures, cybercriminals are simultaneously refining their deceptive tactics, creating an arms race in the digital realm.

Concerns surrounding computer viruses are rife among computer users. Although the deliberate introduction of malicious software into computer systems may not always technically constitute a criminal offense, such actions, often motivated by mischief or malice, can have devastating consequences. Regardless of the perpetrator's intent, the impact on victims can be severe, potentially leading to data deletion, file corruption, or unauthorized data alteration, all of which can have far-reaching consequences.

The field of computer technology is characterized by constant innovation and evolution. Regrettably, this rapid progress is mirrored by a corresponding stream of novel fraudulent schemes. Consequently, all computer users must maintain a state of vigilance and exercise caution to mitigate the risks associated with these evolving cyber threats. It is imperative to stay informed about the latest security measures and best practices to safeguard personal and professional data in an increasingly interconnected world. The onus is on both individuals and organizations to prioritize cybersecurity and adopt a proactive approach to protecting themselves from the ever-present threat of computer crime.

mock_data.translation:
Kompyuterlar zamonaviy hayot uchun shunchalik zarur bo'lib qoldiki, ularning nisbatan yaqinda ixtiro qilinganligiga ishonish qiyin. Shubhasiz, ular katta ahamiyatga ega ekanligi isbotlandi, ammo ularning kamchiliklari ham bor. Bir narsa shundaki, ular bizning allaqachon katta miqdordagi jinoyatlarimizga qo'shildi.

Xakerlik ko'pchiligimiz biladigan birinchi kompyuter jinoyati edi. O'zlarining kompyuter tajribasidan foydalanib, xakerlar deb nomlanuvchi odamlar boshqa birovning kompyuteriga ruxsatsiz kirish huquqini olishlari va u yerda topadigan ma'lumotlardan foydalanishlari mumkin. Ular, masalan, raqobatchilarning mijozlari ro'yxatini olishlari va bulardan o'z bizneslarini qurishda foydalanishlari yoki raqib kompaniyaning rejalarini bilish uchun sanoat josusligining bir shakli sifatida xakerlikdan foydalanishlari mumkin. Boshqa xakerlik faoliyatlari yanada aniqroq jinoiy bo'lishi mumkin, chunki xakerlar boshqa birovning kompyuteridagi moliyaviy ma'lumotlarga kirishlari va uni noqonuniy ravishda o'zgartirishlari yoki firibgarlik maqsadlarida foydalanishlari mumkin.

Internet orqali tovarlarni sotib olishning zamonaviy amaliyoti jiddiy moliyaviy firibgarlik ehtimolini sezilarli darajada oshirdi. Ko'rinishidan, bunday xaridlarni to'lash uchun kredit kartalaridan foydalanish juda ko'p odamlarning katta miqdorda pulidan aldanib qolishiga olib keluvchi rekord darajadagi firibgarlikka olib keldi. Banklar onlayn xavfsizlikni yaxshilash va mijozlar uchun himoya choralarini ta'minlash uchun qattiq ishlashmoqda, ammo firibgarlar o'zlarining buzuq usullarini yaxshilash uchun xuddi shunday qattiq ishlashmoqda.

Ko'plab kompyuter foydalanuvchilari o'zlarining tizimlari kompyuter viruslaridan ta'sirlanishi mumkinligidan tashvishlanishadi. Boshqa odamlarning kompyuter dasturlariga bunday xatolarni kiritadigan odamlar texnik jihatdan jinoyat sodir etmashlari mumkin, ammo buni buzg'unchilik yoki g'azab harakati sifatida qilishlari mumkin. Sabab ma'lumotlari o'chirilgan yoki o'zgartirilgan yoki fayllari buzilgan odamlar uchun haqiqatda muhim emas.

Kompyuterlar yuqori texnik ish usuluning bir qismidir, unda doimo yangi rivojlanishlar mavjud. Afsuski, ular bilan bog'liq firibgarlik sanoatida ham doimiy yangi rivojlanishlar oqimi mavjud. Barcha kompyuter foydalanuvchilari hushyor bo'lishlari kerak.

mock_data.translationB1:
Kompyuterlar hozirda hayotimizning juda muhim qismiga aylandi. Ularning yangi ekanligiga ishonish qiyin. Ular juda foydali bo'ldi, lekin ularda muammolar ham bor. Bir muammo shundaki, ular yangi turdagi jinoyatlarni yaratdi.

Odamlar bilgan birinchi kompyuter jinoyatlaridan biri xakerlik edi. Xakerlar kompyuterlar bilan yaxshi ishlay oladigan odamlardir. Ular boshqa odamlarning kompyuterlariga ruxsatsiz kirishlari mumkin. Keyin ular topgan ma'lumotlardan foydalanishlari mumkin. Masalan, ular kompaniyaning mijozlari ro'yxatini topib, undan o'z biznesiga yordam berish uchun foydalanishlari mumkin. Bu boshqa kompaniyaning sirlarini bilish uchun ularni josuslik qilishga o'xshaydi. Ba'zi xakerlar jiddiyroq ishlar qiladilar. Ular moliyaviy ma'lumotlarga qarab, uni o'zgartirishlari yoki undan pul o'g'irlashlari mumkin.

Hozirda Internet orqali narsalarni onlayn xarid qilish juda keng tarqalgan. Ko'pincha kredit karta orqali to'laysiz. Bu ko'plab firibgarliklarga olib keldi. Ko'p odamlarning pullari aldanib ketdi. Banklar onlayn xaridlarni xavfsizroq qilishga harakat qilmoqda. Ular o'z mijozlarini himoya qilishga harakat qilmoqda. Ammo firibgarlik qiladigan odamlar ham aldashning yangi usullarini topishga harakat qilmoqda.

Ko'pgina kompyuter foydalanuvchilari kompyuter viruslari haqida xavotirda. Bular sizning kompyuteringizga zarar etkazishi mumkin bo'lgan dasturlar.
